beats.text: Why do GPUs sit idle during LLM inference until The 70B Revolution unlocks 4x throughput?
beats.visual_focus: A massive 500B parameter model graphic shrinking down and getting outperformed by a glowing compact 70B core.

visual_blueprint.title: THE SCALING PARADOX
visual_blueprint.sub: Bigger parameter count does not equal optimal intelligence

motif_params.title: THE SCALING PARADOX
motif_params.sub: Bigger parameter count does not equal optimal intelligence

beats.text: Giants like GPT-3 and Gopher were bloated and starved of data. They built massive empty brains that wasted millions in GPU compute.
beats.visual_focus: A gigantic neural network architecture diagram mostly grayed out and empty, with tiny trickle of token streams entering.

visual_blueprint.title: VECTOR FLOW FIELD: EARLY LLMS
visual_blueprint.sub: A gigantic neural network architecture diagram mostly grayed out

motif_params.title: VECTOR FLOW FIELD: EARLY LLMS
motif_params.sub: A gigantic neural network architecture diagram mostly grayed out

beats.text: DeepMind tested four hundred models to uncover the math. The revelation. Model size and training tokens must scale in equal lockstep proportion.
beats.visual_focus: A 3Blue1Brown Pareto frontier plot where compute curves intersect at an exact 1:1 proportional vector.

visual_blueprint.title: THE 70B REVOLUTION ARCHITECTURE
visual_blueprint.sub: A 3Blue1Brown Pareto frontier plot where compute curves intersect

params.sub: A 3Blue1Brown Pareto frontier plot where compute curves intersect

motif_params.title: THE 70B REVOLUTION ARCHITECTURE
motif_params.sub: A 3Blue1Brown Pareto frontier plot where compute curves intersect
motif_params.caption: Adam Adamw

beats.text: Every parameter doubling strictly demands doubling training tokens. Feeding twenty tokens per parameter lets lean models run circles around bloated giants.
beats.visual_focus: Clean chalkboard code block rendering the exact 20-to-1 compute optimal token ratio.

visual_blueprint.title: KERNEL CODE: THE 70B REVOLUTION
visual_blueprint.sub: Clean chalkboard code block rendering the exact 20-to-1 compute o

motif_params.title: KERNEL CODE: THE 70B REVOLUTION

beats.text: The result was Chinchilla. At seventy billion parameters. It demolished Gopher with sixty-seven point five percent accuracy on MMLU while cutting inference costs.
beats.visual_focus: Horizontal benchmark bars showing Chinchilla 70B overtaking Gopher 280B and GPT-3 175B.

beats.text: This compute-optimal ratio birthed modern compact LLMs. Follow machinoAI for daily deep-dives into how frontier architectures actually work.
beats.visual_focus: Chinchilla architectural funnel expanding into open-source models like LLaMA and Mistral with a branded machinoAI crest.

visual_blueprint.sub: Modern LLMs: Dense, trained on trillions of tokens
